title: a16z Podcast: Brains, Bodies, Minds ... and Techno-Religions

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Evolution and technology have allowed our human species to manipulate the physical environment around us -- reshaping fields into cities.
reader_summary.overview: Evolution and technology have allowed our human species to manipulate the physical environment around us -- reshaping fields into cities, redirecting rivers to irrigate farms. But now, we're turning that "innovative gaze" inwards: which means the main products of the 21st century will be bodies, brains, and minds. Or so argues Yuval Harari, author of the bestselling book Sapiens: A Brief History of Mankind and of the new book Homo Deus.

key_points.text: Evolution and technology have allowed our human species to manipulate the physical environment around us -- reshaping fields into cities, redirecting rivers to irrigate farms.
Or so argues Yuval Harari, author of the bestselling book Sapiens: A Brief History of Mankind and of the new book Homo Deus.
What happens when our body parts no longer have to be physically co-located?
